prompt:
Design a Vastu-compliant 2BHK house layout for a 25x35 ft rectangular plot.

Room specifications (include all):
- Living Room (12x14 ft) in the North-East
- Kitchen (8x10 ft) in the South-East
- Master Bedroom (13x15 ft) in the South-West
- Bedroom (10x12 ft) in the North-West
- Common Toilet (6x6 ft) in the North
- Pooja Room (4x4 ft) in the East

Output format:
Return only a valid JSON array. Each room must include:
- "name"
- "x" (integer, starting x-coordinate)
- "y" (integer, starting y-coordinate)
- "width" (in feet)
- "height" (in feet)

Do not add any comments, explanations, or extra text. Output must strictly be a JSON array.
